title: Case Study: Why Copilot Stays in Search Mode
subtitle: Honeywell: From Copilot training to customer-owned AI-assisted iteration

title: Leadership Summary
keyMessage: Honeywell moved from "AI could help with modernization" to customer-owned AI-assisted planning and iteration.
bullets: Started with: AI to help with legacy modernization
Microsoft delivered: Copilot training and Agentic SDLC workshops
Real work surfaced implementation friction the training did not solve
We installed a spec-driven thinking system Copilot could operate against
Customer now runs planning and iteration through AI on their own
Strongest proof: Gary is applying the pattern to two more projects without Microsoft support
bottomLine: Microsoft's value was the framework, not the hand-holding.

title: Senior Engineers Still Use Copilot Like Advanced Search
keyMessage: The default state of Copilot adoption is search mode.
quotes: Most of the org treats Copilot like an advanced Google search.
bottomLine: Copilot stays in Q&A mode when work has no durable system for Copilot to operate against.

title: Knowing the Mechanics != Running Work Through Copilot

bottomLine: Feature awareness is not workflow transformation.
